properties.source_state_identity: Canonical StateIdentity for the normalized source state
properties.destination_state_identity: Canonical StateIdentity for the transformed destination state

YWEGenerationContextPacket.role: Carries YWE-side player, world, realm, perception, and consequence context into ASH-governed generation.
YWEGenerationContextPacket.boundary: Player and world context may influence generation requests but must not mutate ASH math.

PlayerRuntimeState.role: Defines the player-specific runtime state referenced by YWEGenerationContextPacket.player_runtime_state_ref.
PlayerRuntimeState.boundary: Player Runtime State may influence generation context and branch context but must not mutate ASH math, shared world truth, or base world ontology.

PlayerRuntimeStateDelta.role: Records an auditable accepted, rejected, deferred, or merged change to PlayerRuntimeState.
PlayerRuntimeStateDelta.boundary: Runtime deltas require player trace, branch evidence where relevant, diagnostic evidence, generation plan evidence, and source ASH references.

ASHUpstreamGenerationEnvelope.role: Proves upstream ASH authority and binds diagnostics, plan, codeword trace, state snapshot, and provenance.

YWEInterpretationPacket.role: Binds ASH-derived output to YWE domain interpretation and feature-engine exchange.
YWEInterpretationPacket.boundary: YWE interprets ASH-derived pattern truth and does not create an independent symbolic grammar.

PlayerActionTrace.role: Records player action and consequence channels that may influence future ASH-governed context.
PlayerActionTrace.boundary: Player actions influence future generation context; they do not mutate ASH math.

ExplorationFrontierRequest.role: Represents unresolved frontier, threshold, thin-veil, or Yggdrasil-node generation triggers.
ExplorationFrontierRequest.boundary: Unresolved meaningful space requires ASH-governed generation before manifestation.

FutureGenerationBiasUpdate.role: Records downstream consequence pressure for future ASH-governed generation context.
FutureGenerationBiasUpdate.boundary: Bias updates alter downstream context only and never ASH canonical math.

WorldstateDeltaPacket.role: Records persistent Phase 11 consequence after meaningful resolution.
WorldstateDeltaPacket.boundary: Worldstate deltas persist YWE consequence and may influence future generation context but must not mutate ASH math or base world ontology.

LocationMutationState.role: Stores scoped location state changed through accepted worldstate consequence.
LocationMutationState.boundary: Location mutation is scoped to player, branch, shared-world, or realm-local persistence and does not rewrite the nine-plane ontology.

LocationMutationDelta.role: Records an auditable change to LocationMutationState from an accepted WorldstateDeltaPacket.
LocationMutationDelta.boundary: LocationMutationDelta must remain downstream of worldstate evidence, diagnostics, and source ASH references.

WorldstateMutationCommit.role: Commits accepted worldstate and location mutation records with an explicit contradiction policy.
WorldstateMutationCommit.boundary: Commit records preserve append-first consequence and do not silently erase previous worldstate.

DiagnosticNoOp.role: Records a rejected or non-committing mutation request with diagnostic provenance.
DiagnosticNoOp.boundary: Unsupported or unlawful mutation requests fail explicitly instead of silently changing worldstate.

QuestGenerationRequest.role: Binds Phase 12 quest, NPC, lore, or myth generation to player runtime state, branch context, worldstate deltas, future generation bias, diagnostics, and source ASH references.
QuestGenerationRequest.boundary: Generation requests may influence context but may not create independent random content, mutate ASH math, or rewrite accepted world truth.

QuestChainManifest.role: Declares an ASH-derived quest chain with staged interpretation and multiple lawful completion modes.
QuestChainManifest.boundary: Quest chains are interpretive containers and must expose CompletionModeSet.minimum_mode_count >= 2.

QuestResolutionPayload.role: Records selected quest completion mode and downstream worldstate, location, NPC memory, lore, myth, and future bias references.
QuestResolutionPayload.boundary: Quest resolution persists consequence through Phase 11 worldstate and location mutation contracts.

NPCManifest.role: Declares ASH-derived NPC identity, relationship, truth-function, and persistence state.
NPCManifest.boundary: NPC claims and relationships remain interpretive unless backed by an accepted WorldstateDeltaPacket.

NPCMemoryDelta.role: Records append-only NPC memory change from a quest or consequence resolution.
NPCMemoryDelta.boundary: NPC memory changes cannot promote claims into shared world truth without worldstate evidence.

LoreArchiveRecord.role: Stores layered lore with explicit visibility scope and truth boundary.
LoreArchiveRecord.boundary: Generated lore may reference locked canon but cannot overwrite locked canon or protected endgame truth.

MythRecord.role: Stores retrospective myth interpretation and faction-visible myth lines from worldstate-backed consequence.
MythRecord.boundary: Myth records distribute interpretations and may not rewrite factual world truth.

SocialDistributionDelta.role: Records faction and social propagation of myth or lore pressure.
SocialDistributionDelta.boundary: Social distribution may influence future generation context but cannot authorize factual truth changes.

SystemManifestExchange.role: Transfers a YWEInterpretationPacket to an allowed feature engine before host materialization.

AshStateSnapshot.role: Names an ASH state snapshot emitted by the upstream authority for a generation request.

CanonicalCodewordTrace.role: Names the ASH codeword sequence used by upstream generation planning.
